 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE R.P.DHOLARIA  Date : 06/10/2018  ORAL ORDER

Learned advocate for the applicant, on instructions, states that the applicant is ready to deposit a fine of Rs.25,000/-, if this Court may pass appropriate order for quashing and setting aside the impugned order.
On the other hand, learned advocates for the respondents have no objection to the said suggestion made by learned advocate for the applicant.

2. As such, on going through the records, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the applicant-original accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty prescribed for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.
3. In view of the above, this application is allowed.

The impugned order dated 19.07.2018 passed in Criminal Appeal No. 415 of 2017 by learned Additional Sessions Judge, City Sessions Court No.17,
Ahmedabad is hereby quashed and set aside.
